_about: Card packs of You got me Lobster? (locked in diary/DECISIONS_TCG.md; numbers he edits). A pack holds `cards` cards: every card but the last rolls `slot` odds, the last rolls `last` odds (always rare or better). Leaders come at epic odds (each leader weighs like one epic card) and a faction's second leader weighs `second_leader` of that once the player owns a leader of that faction. Foils per card: rainbow / pony chance. Pity: an epic at the latest in pack `pity.epic`, a legendary in pack `pity.legendary` (the last card is raised). God pack: 1 in `god.one_in`, `god.cards` cards all rare or better with `god.odds`. A BOX = `box.packs` packs that together hold at least `box.legendaries` legendaries and `box.epics` epics. Prices in chips at the vending machine (rows: single, bundles, box; starter decks).
